### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — WO2 defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | No journal-specific AI policy page found for ABT itself; only the publisher-level policy from University of California Press (which owns/hosts ABT via online.ucpress.edu) was located. UC Press policy: AI cannot be listed/credited as an author; authors may use AI to improve readability/formatting/grammar of human-written text but must disclose such use to editors and be transparent in the manuscript; AI use to generate original text/images/data analysis requires disclosure; peer reviewers are strictly prohibited from using AI tools to compose review reports or from uploading manuscripts into AI tools (copyright violation); freelance contractors/editors may not use AI to generate original content for UC Press publications. This is publisher-wide, not confirmed as reproduced verbatim in ABT's own author guidelines (the ABT-specific author-guidelines PDF linked from bioone.org could not be opened/parsed in this session). |
| **Source URL** | https://www.ucpress.edu/about/ai-guidelines |

**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** K-16 (largely secondary/undergraduate) biology and life-science education content: content-focused articles explaining biology topics for teachers, classroom/lab/field teaching-strategy pieces and activities, commentaries on social/ethical implications of biology, and professional-development pieces for biology teachers. 2025 issues (Vol 87) sampled include: epigenetics-and-disease teaching piece, remote biology education/student safety, visual-art integration & drawing-to-learn in histology, active learning, distance education, field work, inclusive education, and a piece on college-prep STEM programs addressing poverty/free-reduced-lunch populations.

**Methods noted as welcome (WO2, qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** classroom/lab teaching activities & strategies, field-based activities, content/explainer articles on biology topics for a teacher audience, commentaries on social & ethical implications of biology, professional development pieces, book/product/technology reviews for the classroom

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **peer_review.type**: No source specifies single-blind vs double-blind vs open review; only that it is 'peer-refereed'. The ABT-specific author guidelines PDF (linked from bioone.org) could not be fetched/parsed to confirm.
- **preprint.allowed**: No ABT-specific or UC Press journal-wide preprint policy statement was found via search or the (403-blocked) UC Press submission page; author-guidelines PDF not accessible in this session.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No numeric desk-reject rate found on SciRev (0 reviews), LetPub (only qualitative 'easy' acceptance label), muchong (stale single entry), or any Reddit/AskAcademia thread (none found mentioning this journal).
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No first-hand forum narrative (muchong had only one stale 2012 entry with no substantive comment; no Reddit/AskAcademia/Zhihu threads found discussing this journal specifically).
- **ai_policy source specificity**: Only the UC Press publisher-level AI guidelines page was accessible; the ABT-specific author guidelines PDF (via nabt.org/bioone.org) that would confirm whether ABT reproduces or supplements this policy could not be opened in this session (online.ucpress.edu/abt/pages/submit returned HTTP 403).

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per WO2 rules):**
- 小木虫 muchong.com (jid=393): only one stale user entry from 2012, no substantive review-time/acceptance data - effectively 0 usable results
- LetPub (Chinese, letpub.com.cn): usable data found - 50 aggregated user submissions giving review speed '6-12周' (6-12 weeks, rated 'slow'), acceptance rated '容易' (easy), composite score 4.9/10
- 知乎 zhihu: not separately queried beyond general web search; no zhihu-specific thread on this journal surfaced in results
- Reddit r/AskAcademia: general web search returned no threads mentioning 'American Biology Teacher' journal - 0 results
- SciRev (not Chinese, but query-time crowd source per work order): 0 reviews submitted, all fields n/a
